resources.string: Pair this phone with your own Klean server to keep your phone, watch and browser in step.
Optional. Klean works fully on this phone without it. On the web, open Settings, choose Pair a device, then scan the code or paste its link here.
Point the camera at the code on the web
Everything stays on this phone. It just stops syncing with %1$s.
That doesn\'t look like a pairing link. Copy it from Klean on the web.
That code has run out or was already used. Make a new one on the web.
Couldn\'t reach the server. Check the address and that this phone is online.
The server couldn\'t pair right now. Try again in a moment.
Can\'t reach the server right now. Klean keeps working and tries again on its own.
The server had a problem. Klean tries again later on its own.
This phone was removed on the server. Pair it again to keep syncing.
